name: PostgreSQL
shortDescription: Self-hosted developer platform with Git hosting, pull requests, code review and artifact registries, backed by PostgreSQL.

alerts.message: Sign up right after deployment: the first account becomes the administrator. Public sign-up closes once that account exists; set GITNESS_USER_SIGNUP_ENABLED to true to let others register.
Pipelines and Gitspaces need the host Docker socket and are not available in this template. Git over SSH is disabled; clone and push over HTTPS.
